address: Korunni 88, Praha 2 - Vinohrady
rent: 24000
total_monthly: 27500
kauce: 48000
commission: unknown
move_in_date: 2026-12-01
lease_type: najem

tool.name: submit_call_result
tool.description: Save the final result of the call. Call exactly once, after the realtor confirmed a viewing time or once it is clear no viewing will be booked, and before saying goodbye.

outcome.description: booked only if the realtor explicitly agreed to and confirmed a viewing time fully inside a free window. Otherwise not_booked.

viewing_start.description: Agreed viewing start as ISO 8601 with the Europe/Prague offset, for example 2026-11-14T10:30:00+01:00. Set only when outcome is booked. Leave out when not booked.

answers.description: One item per open question asked during the call.

items.description: A question and the realtor's answer.

question.description: The open question, as listed in the prompt.

answer.description: What the realtor said, in a few words. Use unknown when they did not know or did not answer.

new_costs.description: Costs the realtor mentioned that are not in the fact sheet. Empty list when there are none.

items.description: One cost with a stated amount.

label.description: Short name of the cost, for example parking or internet.

recurring.description: true when the cost repeats monthly, false when it is paid once.

summary.description: One or two sentences on what happened in the call, with the reason when not booked.
